body.name: Dominance-and-symmetry certificate handle
body.construction: Start from the exhaustive \(\mathsf{Cert}\) grammar and design \(\mathsf{Handle}\) by quotienting candidates with identical action-score cost columns, adding dominance rules between residual vectors, and reusing exact optimistic-descendant evaluations across isomorphic subtrees; the generated object must remain consumable by \(\mathsf{Check}\).
